status: Policy proposals; not legal requirements or guaranteed reductions

solutions.title: Use the smallest adequate model
solutions.metric: kWh per successfully completed task; accuracy and failure rate
solutions.action: Route routine requests to smaller models; reserve larger models for tasks that need them.
solutions.caution: Benchmark at the same quality and latency; a smaller model is not always sufficient.

solutions.title: Reuse results and models
solutions.metric: Cache hit rate; avoided runs; total monthly kWh
solutions.action: Cache repeat outputs where privacy permits; reuse trained models before starting new training.
solutions.caution: Check stale answers, privacy and retraining needs.

solutions.title: Cap wasteful computation
solutions.metric: GPU watts; kWh/job; completion time
solutions.action: Test power caps, batching and idle-server shutdown against a service target.
solutions.caution: Longer runtime can offset lower power; measure energy, not watts alone.

solutions.title: Set an absolute energy budget
solutions.metric: Monthly MWh and tCO₂e, alongside useful output
solutions.action: Require annual resource budgets and a documented review before expansion.
solutions.caution: Efficiency alone can be overwhelmed by increased use; this is a proposed governance control.

solutions.title: Commission clean supply before load
solutions.metric: New deliverable clean MWh; commissioning dates
solutions.action: Stage new load against verified delivery of additional low-emission supply and grid capacity.
solutions.caution: A contract or distant certificate does not establish local or hourly delivery.

solutions.title: Match power by time and place
solutions.metric: Hourly clean-energy coverage; location-based tCO₂e
solutions.action: Disclose hourly supply gaps and both location-based and applicable market-based inventories.
solutions.caution: Hourly matching is a proposed stronger procurement condition; certificates do not erase local pollution.

solutions.title: Shift flexible work with health safeguards
solutions.metric: Marginal CO₂ and pollutant changes; latency
solutions.action: Schedule deferrable jobs using carbon and public-health signals together.
solutions.caution: Han’s modeled gains are not field-proven universal savings; do not export harm to another community.

solutions.title: Make flexibility enforceable
solutions.metric: Verified curtailable MW; response time; rebound load
solutions.action: Contract and test load reductions during grid stress, with limits on diesel substitution.
solutions.caution: Protect essential services and account for catch-up demand after the event.

solutions.title: Choose the least harmful viable site
solutions.metric: Basin stress; exposed population; grid constraints
solutions.action: Compare alternative sites and cumulative impacts before buying into a single location.
solutions.caution: National income and average grid carbon are inadequate siting scores.

solutions.title: Budget water for drought
solutions.metric: Withdrawal and consumption m³/day; drought allocation
solutions.action: Meter sources separately and set drought triggers, curtailment and protected community supply.
solutions.caution: Dry cooling can increase electricity; reclaimed water also has treatment and ecological costs.

solutions.title: Reduce routine diesel use
solutions.metric: Generator hours; fuel; NOx and PM emissions
solutions.action: Assess batteries and cleaner backup; meter generator tests and enforce operating conditions.
solutions.caution: Battery duration, fire protection and reliability require engineering; backup is not automatically replaceable.

solutions.title: Measure exposure near people
solutions.metric: PM₂.₅, NO₂; nighttime noise; modeled concentration change
solutions.action: Use baseline and follow-up monitoring at sensitive receptors, supported by dispersion analysis.
solutions.caution: Sensors alone cannot attribute disease to a site; near-field impacts need more than regional screening.

solutions.title: Extend useful hardware life
solutions.metric: Service years; embodied tCO₂e; energy per task
solutions.action: Compare repair and reuse with replacement using lifecycle emissions.
solutions.caution: Older equipment may consume more power; assess the break-even point.

solutions.title: Buy lower-carbon construction
solutions.metric: Verified material quantities and product tCO₂e
solutions.action: Specify lower-emission concrete and steel with comparable performance and product declarations.
solutions.caution: Use consistent lifecycle boundaries; do not double-count supplier emissions.

solutions.title: Recover useful heat where feasible
solutions.metric: Delivered useful MWh; net avoided emissions
solutions.action: Build heat reuse only with a real nearby heat customer and a verified displaced heat source.
solutions.caution: Pumping, seasonal demand and backup heat can reduce the benefit.

solutions.title: Track equipment to its end of life
solutions.metric: Mass reused; verified downstream recovery; hazardous waste
solutions.action: Require take-back contracts and independently trace downstream treatment.
solutions.caution: A recycling receipt alone does not establish safe recovery or prevent exported harm.

solutions.title: Charge for dedicated infrastructure
solutions.metric: Project-attributable grid/water costs; household bill change
solutions.action: Recover attributable connection and expansion costs through regulator-reviewed tariffs and exit security.
solutions.caution: Allocate shared benefits fairly; avoid charging the same cost twice.

solutions.title: Price residual damage transparently
solutions.metric: tCO₂e; pollutant-specific modeled damage ranges
solutions.action: Combine emissions limits with a transparent residual-damage charge and community mitigation funding.
solutions.caution: Requires legal authority; taxes already paid must be reconciled. Fees never substitute for health limits.

solutions.title: Fund independent public scrutiny
solutions.metric: Audit completion; data availability; grievances resolved
solutions.owner: Developer pays regulator-administered fund / all phases
solutions.action: Publish phase, owners, forecasts, measured use, exceedances and enforceable conditions in a common registry.
solutions.caution: Independent review needs protection from sponsor influence and safeguards for genuinely sensitive data.

solutions.title: Prove local and climate benefits
solutions.metric: Permanent jobs; net local revenue; verified net avoided tCO₂e
solutions.action: Audit promised benefits and test AI-enabled savings against a credible non-AI baseline.
solutions.caution: Report additional computing and rebound; speculative future savings cannot cancel today’s footprint.
